mechanism: Acquire equal actual quantities of every NO token in one fixed nonaugmented negative-risk event; convert all registered question indices to pUSD. No event-resolution waiting and no post-conversion market sales are credited.
conversion_algebra: For n>1 registered outcomes and native integer Q of each NO, F=floor(Q*b/10000), R=Q-F; complete-index conversion returns(n-1)*R collateral and no YES. This is source-based algebra, not observed live execution.
documentation_discrepancy: The current registry, position guide and July14 changelog agree on the wrapper; the official repository README lists a different address. Use the current documented address for any later fixed chain binding; deployed code/source equivalence is not yet established.

event_selection.topic: The next scheduled Federal Reserve rate decision, October28,2026; selected from the official calendar before any market response.
event_selection.required_later_properties: All registered outcomes; same event and neg-risk market ID; active, not closed/archived, no augmented placeholders; resolution text exhaustive and mutually exclusive; contract-derived question count/index/token mapping; all required fields observable. Missing or ambiguous facts remain unavailable.

request_plan.purpose: Discover one event and project its structural metadata, without inspecting prices or depth.

metadata_projection: Search summaries: id,title,slug,endDate and match reasons for every returned event. For the unique candidate only, retain description/timing/state/negative-risk fields and every market question/description/condition ID/outcome/token IDs/trading constraints/fee schedule. Preserve unknown/missing values. Exclude prices, best bids/asks, last trades, volume, liquidity, rewards and unrelated profiles from analytical outputs. Raw metadata may contain incidental indicative prices; they are not inspected or used.
run_gate: Root reviewed source and focused offline tests and pinned both below. One root metadata GET is authorized only with this exact plan SHA; existing output directory is refused. No subsequent query, retry, contract RPC or economics is authorized by this plan.

decision_rule.advance: One unambiguous structurally plausible candidate warrants semantic review and a separately frozen contract-mapping preflight.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Transport/resource/schema failure, zero or multiple candidates, missing/contradictory metadata, or incomplete event structure. No silent query/market substitution.
decision_rule.maximum_conclusion: Availability of projected public event metadata only; no quote, price edge, fill, conversion completion or profit conclusion.

later_economic_requirements: Before quotes: validate complete event-to-chain mapping and actual metadata/fees. Freeze native sizes, calendar, depth, receipt/source clocks, freshness and all missing states. Book inequalities are only necessary conditions. Any subsequent paper cycle requires every acquisition debit and fill, conversion cost/timing, reserved capital, failed/partial basket unwind, and zero terminal inventory. No marked residual profit or held-to-resolution substitute.
literature_limit: The2026 paper motivates studying an executable conversion direction. Its historical conversion profit estimate mixes sales with marked residual positions, and its supported-side duration sample is small. It does not establish our current closed-cash edge.
exclusions: No orders, credentials, wallet access, real balances, transaction submission, contract deployment, shared/reserved captures, economic search, fee/reward account claims or market alternatives.

offline_validation.source_review: Root full source/test review, then narrow final delta; independent Sol review of request/body/time scope, metadata allowlist and missing core fields found no further blocker. Final changes add market neg-risk availability checks, exact two source pins and pre-claim verification timer.
